errors.equivocation: This link holds a different copy of a version you have. Ghostly kept yours.
errors.expired: That took too long. Check the app again.
errors.githubLink: That GitHub page is not an app. Paste the repository's link, or the link to its app file.
errors.host: Apps come only from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) or jsDelivr at a commit.
errors.needsFiles: Its files are not on this device yet.
errors.notListed: This store no longer lists that app.
errors.notSigned: Not signed correctly. Ghostly won't install it.
errors.otherApp: The link holds a different app.
errors.removed: A store you added removed this app.
errors.rollback: The link holds an older version.
errors.storage: This browser can't keep apps here (private browsing?). Try a normal window.
errors.storageInfo: Ghostly keeps each app's files on this device. Private windows, like Safari's Private Browsing, don't let it, and a full disk stops it too. Open Ghostly in a normal window and install the app there.
errors.storeKey: That store is signed by a different key.

install.equivocation: Two different versions {{sequence}} exist. Ghostly kept the one you have.
install.ipInfo: Ghostly downloads the app from {{host}}, which learns your IP address and when.
install.ipInfoOffline: The app has no internet access, but its publisher may still learn your IP address and when you open it.
install.ipLine: Downloads from {{host}}, which sees your IP address.
install.ipLineInstalled: Its publisher may learn your IP address.
install.notListed: Not in any of your stores

perm.chat: Talk to the same app on your contact's side
perm.internetInfo: The app and the servers it talks to can learn your IP address and what you do in it.
perm.name: See your name in this chat
perm.storage: Keep its own data on this device

install.unknownPublisherInfo: Anyone can sign an app with a new key. Only a store you added can vouch for who made it. Compare the key with the one the maker publishes.
install.webkit: In this browser, an app can still contact other servers.
install.webkitInfo: Safari, and every browser on iPhone and iPad, lets an app open connections Ghostly cannot block, even without the internet permission. Those servers learn your IP address. The desktop app blocks them.

page.addHint: Add an app or a store by its link
page.intro: Games and small apps, signed by their makers and run in a sandbox.
page.noStores: No stores yet. Add one by its link.
